summary: Isolate the repeated-header resource preflight fixture from native process and OS discovery so its real CPU parser, thresholds and missing-measurement refusal run on Ubuntu CI and macOS without skipping behavior. Production guard code is unchanged.

diagnosis: The fixture controlled CPU/memory/swap/disk data but unintentionally invoked real macOS process discovery and platform detection on the Ubuntu checks runner. External OS/process inputs were missing from its controlled dependencies.

red_green.green: The copied guard now supplies a macOS OS-adapter identity plus allowlisted external process snapshot outputs. The hostile preload remains active in all three cases, proving no native command is needed. Safe 11 percent admits, 75 percent refuses RESOURCE_CPU_BUSY, missing interval refuses cpu-busy:sample-count.
